history.administration_response: The Office of Human Resources requests that this recommendation be closed, given that it issued updated guidance on fixed- term limited appointments on 7 January 2025. The updated policy guidance is applicable to all Secretariat entities, including the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, and supersedes any guidance on fixed-term limited appointments that was in place before the issuance of the updated guidance.
history.board_assessment: Given that the updated guidance has been issued, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
